## Pickering Fall 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [Pickering Fall A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PickeringFallA2023). You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.***

### Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: V-Cube Spiel B 2023
items.information:
V-Cubes is proud to bring back cubing competitions to Spiel Messe in Essen!
**Note:** V-Cube Spiel B 2023 is a series competition to V-Cube Spiel A 2023 on the same weekend. Please note that you may only register for one of the two competitions.

V-Cubes ist stolz darauf, wieder Speedcubing-Turniere auf der SPIEL Messe in Essen präsentieren zu dürfen!
**Wichtig:** V-Cube Spiel A 2023 ist eine Partner-Competition von V-Cube Spiel B 2023, die am gleichen Wochenende stattfindet. Bitte beachte, dass du dich nur für eines der beiden Turniere anmelden darfst. 

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbDRkIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ef25795363481ab9b918d882fa96ca2c55097150/v-cube.png)

To participate in this competition, you must have a ticket for Sunday at the Essen Spiel Messe exposition. This ticket needs to be bought individually and is not included in the registration fee.
The competition will take place at Hall 5, Booth 5A108. You can see the site plan of Messe Essen [here](https://www.messe-essen.de/media/neue-medien/dreiklang/anreise-parkplaetze-downloads/gelaendeplaene/messe_essen_gelaendeplan.pdf).

If you are a new competitor, take a look at the corresponding tab. All competitors should be familiar with the information in the tab.

Um an diesem Wettbewerb teilnehmen zu können, brauchst du ein Ticket für den Sonntag der Essen Spiel Messe. Dieses Ticket muss individuell erworben werden und ist nicht im Eintrittspreis enthalten.
Das Turnier findet in Halle 5 am Stand 5A108 statt. Den Geländeplan der Messe Essen findest du [hier](https://www.messe-essen.de/media/neue-medien/dreiklang/anreise-parkplaetze-downloads/gelaendeplaene/messe_essen_gelaendeplan.pdf).

First competition held in Belmont, CA!

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
* Competitors may only bring one guest maximum.

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.
## Competitors are limited to ONE guest. Spectators who are not associated with a registered competitor will NOT be permitted to enter the venue.

## Ontario Favourites Fall 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [Pickering Favourites Fall 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PickeringFavouritesFall2023). You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.***

### Registration Reminders

Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most five (5) events**. 

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
